title: Tale of the Hireling and the Girl

full_text:
In a village near Aleppo, a wealthy landowner hired a young orphan laborer named Tariq to tend his olive groves and harvest the fruit. While the other laborers worked only when the overseer was watching, Tariq pruned every branch with dedicated skill, gathered every fallen olive, and watered the roots as if the orchard belonged to his own father.

The landowner, observing his quiet diligence from his terrace, resolved to test his integrity.

He placed an unsealed purse containing thirty gold dinars among the roots of an ancient olive tree where Tariq was digging an irrigation trench.

Tariq struck the leather pouch with his spade, picked it up, and saw the gleaming gold within. Without a second’s hesitation, he carried the purse immediately to the landowner’s mansion: 'Master, I found this purse buried beneath the third tree; someone has lost his treasure!'

The landowner smiled with tears of admiration: 'Tariq, that gold was placed there by my own hand to test your soul! A man who is faithful in the dust is worthy to manage an empire.'

The landowner adopted the honest orphan as his partner, gave him his virtuous daughter in marriage, and bequeathed him the vast olive estates, demonstrating that honest labor is the truest foundation of nobility.
moral: Conscientious labor performed with integrity in small matters earns the highest crown of trust.
